decision: Coordinator decision 2: SIMULATION-ONLY teacher collection envelopes are ADVISORY. Record both estimates, never block on their size. v89_translation_source.qualification: Coordinator-specified assumptions, not an independently qualified motion model.

integration: All absolute command leases in [0,370] seconds, including steps and PRBS; no sign cancellation anywhere. Initial hold, coasts and camera/arm tail remain in this window.
geometry: Robot/arm bound 0.40 m; yaw tip translation <= R*min(total_abs_yaw,2). Loaded: tip radius = max(0.40, chassis-to-beam-centre + beam half-diagonal); add half-diagonal to both carrier discs. Beam-start disc encloses both carrier discs.
qualification: Advisory estimates for simulation-only teacher data; not qualified motion bounds, hardware safety, P03/carry/E2E evidence.
pair_cancellation_estimate: Peak absolute signed step integral per robot/axis plus all absolute non-step leases including PRBS; outbound pair excursion is retained. Assumes symmetric fixed-axis response, ignores lag and yaw coupling. Never cancels between carriers; not a motion bound.
start_pose_check: Block at wall distance <= 0.30 m + robot bound 0.40 m (numeric guard 1e-10 m). Also check beam start with its half-diagonal + 0.30 m. Missing/NaN geometry blocks.
